name: Ordinary bounded processing or recovery
conditions: Readable authoritative records and available capacity with no unresolved effect or identity conflict
feedback: No self-sustaining failure loop stipulated. Finite work drains when service exceeds arrivals
entry: Valid work is admitted or a finite interruption ends with sufficient evidence
exit: Work finishes or a new perturbation moves it elsewhere
survives: Committed task identity and readable inputs support remaining work. Verified outputs remain useful
lost: Time during interruption and any uncommitted computation need not survive
falsifier: Backlog grows after arrivals stop or completion requires evidence assumed available
evidence: SOURCE supports individual transactions only. QUALITATIVE bounded-drain assumption is not a measured attractor

name: Local execution physically unavailable
conditions: Required machine or compatible runtime is unavailable and no usable substitute is active
feedback: No internal restoring or reinforcing loop. Unavailable hardware or power continuously maintains outage
entry: Shutdown for battery safety or power loss or platform incompatibility
exit: Replacement compatible execution with readable state and access. Data loss may instead lead to OP006
survives: Off-device readable records and external completed work if they exist. Local disk may survive shutdown but is not usable yet
lost: Live computation and local service availability. Durable data loss is not implied by outage alone
falsifier: Work continues on an independent available machine with no dependence on failed device
evidence: QUALITATIVE physical availability reasoning. No hardware observation or deployment inventory

name: Capacity-limited backlog
conditions: Continuing arrival rate exceeds effective service under throttling or provider limits. Queue retains work
feedback: Arrivals maintain backlog. Congestion alone is not an autonomous attractor and a finite wake-up burst should drain
entry: Reduced service capacity or large accumulated backlog
exit: Arrival reduction or restored service above arrivals. Dropping stale work also changes the workload rather than proving convergence
survives: Queued durable requests and completed independent work if admission and storage remain bounded
lost: Latency and deadline validity. Unbounded intake can additionally exhaust storage
falsifier: Backlog fails to drain after input stops with healthy positive service and no retry generation
evidence: QUALITATIVE rate comparison. Scheduler and provider throughput not measured

name: Work-amplification trap
conditions: Retries or newly created tasks generate more effective load than useful completion removes and overload causes further timeouts or recreations
feedback: More backlog raises latency which causes retries or duplicate tasks which enlarge backlog. Requires endogenous regeneration beyond the initial disturbance. Without a bounded recurrent high-load regime this is runaway growth not an established attractor
entry: A finite burst crosses a timeout or task-reproduction threshold under a permissive retry policy
exit: Stop endogenous generation or reduce reproduction below completion while preserving original identities. A hard budget may move to OP018 or OP031
survives: Original durable work and some completed artifacts if queue and storage remain usable
lost: Predictable progress and bounded resource use. Eventually records may become inaccessible if storage fills
falsifier: After external arrivals stop the backlog reliably drains without policy or capacity change. No latency-to-generation link is observed
evidence: QUALITATIVE nonlinear-loop hypothesis only. No workload trace or executable model. Not empirically established

name: Accepted but invalid work product
conditions: A semantically wrong result passes current validation and is stored or consumed without independent correction
feedback: No necessary dynamical attraction. Reuse may spread the error but persistence alone is a retained bad fact
entry: Silent memory corruption or stale price or weak quality review enters accepted output
exit: Independent validation supersedes the bad result and downstream uses are identified. Historical wrong decisions remain facts
survives: Task records and unaffected artifacts. Their existence does not establish correctness of the compromised output
lost: Confidence in result semantics and dependent decisions rather than necessarily all data
falsifier: Independent comparison shows the output is correct or the validation rejects it before acceptance
evidence: SOURCE completion validates representation not task-specific correctness. QUALITATIVE propagation is conditional
source_refs: C5 scenarios.csv S004 S028 S078 S098

name: Only recoverable information destroyed
kind: absorbing loss relative to stated inventory
conditions: All copies of particular required information including accessible keys are gone and no independent reconstruction source exists
feedback: No feedback needed. Information destruction is absorbing only relative to the explicit closed inventory
entry: Co-located copies destroyed or last retained content deleted or all unique decryption information lost
exit: No exact recovery within the stated inventory. Discovery of an independent copy refutes the inventory rather than reverses destruction
survives: Only independently retained unrelated records and external evidence not destroyed
lost: Exact lost content and any reconstruction that requires it. Not automatically every company capability
falsifier: A readable independent copy or complete independent reconstruction is found
evidence: QUALITATIVE information argument. Backup inventory and actual destruction are not observed

name: Authority and confidentiality compromised
kind: persistent exposure with unresolved damage extent
conditions: Unlocked stolen device or untrusted caller has effective access beyond intended authority
feedback: Continuing access allows further actions while retained credentials remain accepted. Actual attacker behavior is not stipulated
entry: Theft or authentication bypass or unintended reachable listener plus exploitable access
exit: Authority is invalidated and trusted administration restored. Already disclosed information cannot be made secret again
survives: Independent trusted copies and evidence held outside compromised authority if present
lost: Trust in actions under exposed identity and potentially confidentiality. Extent cannot be inferred from reachability alone
falsifier: Access was cryptographically unavailable or no unauthorized capability can be exercised in the stated configuration
evidence: QUALITATIVE conditional breach. DESIGN authentication boundary is not an implemented end-to-end proof
source_refs: D1 section 9 D2 section 7 scenarios.csv S005 S058 S066

name: Mutation cannot commit
conditions: Durable write cannot succeed due to unavailable storage or exhausted required resources and writer invocation is ordered after successful intent commit
feedback: No internal positive feedback required. Persistent resource failure keeps repeated admission attempts failing
entry: Disk-full or disconnected volume before a required transaction completes
exit: Storage becomes writable and a fresh attempt is validated. If a writer already ran use OP014 or OP022 instead
survives: Previously committed readable records and independent read-only work. No new intent is claimed durable
lost: New mutation availability and uncommitted changes. Existing data need not be lost
falsifier: Writer is invoked even though its prerequisite transaction failed on the inspected path
evidence: SOURCE deliver propagates commit errors before write_prompt. Storage survival is a hardware assumption

name: Canonical reconstruction unavailable
conditions: Required historical facts cannot be read or decoded reliably and reconstruction stops rather than fabricating them
feedback: No attracting loop. Repeated deterministic attempts fail at the same incompatibility or damaged input until something changes
entry: Corrupt canonical event or unsupported payload or genuinely inconsistent database
exit: Readable validated original content or compatible decoder. Exact missing facts may instead imply OP006
survives: Unaffected readable records and independent artifacts. Complete replay is not available
lost: Ability to claim a complete reconstructed history past the failing point
falsifier: The same verified inputs replay fully without unsupported guessing or changing semantics
evidence: DESIGN deterministic replay stop at cursor. Current relational migration library is not an implemented event reducer

name: History depends on current registry
conditions: Replay uses mutable present-day registry rather than historical values and those values affect reduction
feedback: Different registry inputs reproduce different outputs from the same log. This is input dependence not proof of dynamical convergence
entry: Historical replay reads today's renamed or moved scope
exit: Historical values are recovered and a pure replay reproduces stable output. If those values were never retained exact history stays unknown
survives: Raw retained events and unaffected source content if intact
lost: Trust in reconstructed historical authorization or routing and comparisons across replays
falsifier: Changing today's registry while replaying identical events never changes the result for the supposedly dependent transition
evidence: DESIGN forbids mutable reducer inputs. QUALITATIVE counterexample assumes a reducer violating that promise

name: Restored history has an unseen tail
conditions: Snapshot is older than real actions and later attempts or effects are absent from restored records
feedback: Repeated local inspection cannot recover omitted facts. Resending may create OP023 rather than supply knowledge
entry: Old restore or missing WAL produces apparently queued tasks whose later delivery is not represented
exit: Independent post-snapshot journal or participant evidence resolves the gap. Otherwise explicit uncertainty persists
survives: The snapshot prefix and independently retained artifacts. Queued status in the prefix is not proof of never delivered in reality
lost: Knowledge of later attempts and effects and safe inference from absent rows
falsifier: Snapshot plus verified journal covers every later attempt or the participant proves none occurred
evidence: SOURCE restore acts only on rows present and leaves queued-without-attempt eligible. QUALITATIVE absent-tail hazard

name: Recorded result outlives its bytes
conditions: Task or event retains an artifact path but referenced bytes are absent changed or collided on restore
feedback: No self-repair from a path string. Repeated reads return missing or different bytes until a separate source appears
entry: Manual artifact deletion or later overwrite or lossy file export
exit: Restore verified original bytes or explicitly supersede the result. If no copy exists the lost content is OP006
survives: Task identifiers summaries paths and other surviving artifacts. A path is useful evidence of intention but not the old content
lost: The exact referenced result and ability to verify conclusions depending on it
falsifier: Content at the reference remains immutable and matches a retained original integrity value
evidence: SOURCE task completion stores path strings without inspecting bytes. DESIGN immutable references are stronger

name: Intact material inaccessible to owner
conditions: Readable storage or encrypted backups exist but all currently usable owner access or decryption paths are absent
feedback: No endogenous loop required. Recovery instructions behind the same inaccessible boundary reproduce the dependency
entry: Lost key or credentials with intact ciphertext or instructions trapped on the sole device
exit: Independent key escrow or account recovery or an independently readable instruction path. Proven absence of all key material may mean OP006
survives: Intact ciphertext and external records retain potential value but cannot currently serve the owner
lost: Operational access not necessarily underlying bits. Time-sensitive work may expire
falsifier: An independent valid recovery path is already usable with the stated surviving resources
evidence: QUALITATIVE dependency analysis without inspection of real credentials or backups

name: Possibly delivered prompt held for decision
conditions: A delivery attempt is durable but prompt receipt is unknown or a restored task may already have run
feedback: Repeated ordinary deliver calls exhaust the unchanged authorization budget and refuse. This is an imposed safety fixed point not an attractor
entry: Crash between attempt commit and outcome recording or restored running/attempted task
exit: Independent receipt/result evidence or an explicit further authorization after considering old work. Authorization alone does not prove duplication safe
survives: Attempt identity prompt task and known assignment if retained. Human can inspect the record without sending again
lost: Automatic progress and knowledge whether prompt actually reached worker
falsifier: A repeated deliver with no new authorization calls the writer again on the inspected path
evidence: SOURCE deliver and authorise_resume plus restore reconcile. No external participant guarantee follows

name: Workspace reserved with uncertain occupant
conditions: Session is disconnected and lease remains while identity or liveness cannot be positively reconciled
feedback: Lease exclusion prevents a second managed start but supplies no new observation. Persistence depends on absent evidence or human decision
entry: Observer loss or restore of lease-holding session
exit: Same live session is authoritatively correlated or old writers are positively accounted for before release. Premature release may enter OP016
survives: Recorded session identity workspace and durable lease. Independent workspaces may remain usable
lost: Managed reuse of that workspace and trustworthy live status. Existing harness may still make progress
falsifier: Disconnected sessions automatically relinquish the lease or another managed start succeeds for the same stable file identity
evidence: SOURCE restore retains leases and begin_start checks aliases. Broader process-tree evidence not demonstrated

name: Untracked or overlapping writers
conditions: A process retains write capability while Factory believes it stopped or a human/replacement also edits the same workspace
feedback: Ongoing writers overwrite or invalidate one another's assumptions. Continued conflicting activity is required so this is not automatically autonomous
entry: Orphan process or premature recovery recreation or manual pane replacement followed by reuse
exit: All writers are accounted for and work is reconciled before exclusive reuse. Already overwritten data may remain lost
survives: Separate unmodified files durable task journal and recoverable versions if present
lost: Exclusive workspace semantics and attribution of file changes. Terminal absence does not establish process absence
falsifier: No surviving process can write after the alleged stop and no overlapping human edits occur
evidence: SOURCE recovery can presume gone without authoritative identity. QUALITATIVE OS/process and human-write branches

name: Permission or approval pending
conditions: Required authorization is absent expired or bound to a different proposed action and the boundary actually checks it
feedback: No autonomous attraction. Repeated attempts without a changed valid authorization remain inadmissible
entry: Worker permission question or approval expiration before acceptance or changed invoice/report payload
exit: Authorized actor reviews the exact current effect or cancels it. Past acceptance cannot be undone by local approval changes
survives: Task inputs pending intent and prior audit evidence. Independent already authorized work may continue
lost: Progress on gated effect not necessarily data or all worker availability
falsifier: The supposedly checked boundary accepts an absent expired or mismatched approval
evidence: SOURCE blocked assignments stay occupied. External content-bound approval checks remain DESIGN/QUALITATIVE

name: Plugin activation quarantined
conditions: Supervisor enforces bounded restart/protocol-failure budget for one activation and isolates optional failures
feedback: Failures consume a finite budget then automatic restart stops. Operator retry is an external reset not endogenous healing
entry: Repeated crash malformed protocol or manifest mismatch reaches supervisor failure path
exit: Validated configuration or executable change and explicit operator retry. Repeating the same defective activation may re-enter
survives: Core local records and other enabled capabilities if isolation and local transport work
lost: Affected plugin capability and its queued operations. In-flight outcome can remain OP022 independently
falsifier: Activation restarts forever after the configured budget or optional failure prevents safe-mode startup
evidence: DESIGN lifecycle only. No plugin-host crate observed in inspected workspace layout

name: Restart without useful service
conditions: An automatic restart policy repeatedly launches the same failing plugin and resets or lacks a finite budget
feedback: Crash triggers restart which re-executes the defect and crashes. Policy provides the recurrence after the original trigger
entry: Deterministic startup defect plus unbounded automatic retries or manual resets
exit: Budget exhaustion enters OP018 or the defect/configuration changes
survives: Core records if process isolation and resource bounds hold. Some diagnostics may survive
lost: Plugin business progress and resources consumed by restart/log churn
falsifier: Same activation reaches stable ready service or a non-resetting budget stops the cycle
evidence: DESIGN bounded budget would prevent infinite automatic cycling. Unbounded/resetting policy is QUALITATIVE alternative

name: Apparently live dependency makes no business progress
conditions: Health requests succeed but relevant operations never finish or provider continues rejecting them
feedback: Health success may preserve routing while business deadlines generate repeated stuck work. A growth loop additionally needs OP004 assumptions
entry: Plugin business deadlock or multi-day rate limit with continuing attempted dispatch
exit: Business path recovers or dispatch stops and pending outcomes are reconciled. A health response alone is not an exit
survives: Local task records and unaffected business paths. Accepted remote work may remain uncertain
lost: Progress for affected operations and adequacy of health as a readiness proxy
falsifier: Representative business requests complete under the same conditions without intervention
evidence: QUALITATIVE liveness distinction. DESIGN bounds health checks but does not prove business health from them

name: Partial service with independent local work
conditions: Failed optional capability is not on every useful work path and core plus local access remain healthy
feedback: No failure attraction. Continued absence of the optional component maintains partial service while independent work completes
entry: HTTP transport failure or isolated optional plugin rejection or bounded slow-client disconnect
exit: Capability restored or task routing explicitly accepts permanent absence
survives: Local inspection task records and operations not depending on failed plugin or remote client
lost: Specific remote channel subscription or optional business operation only
falsifier: Every useful task or local recovery actually depends on the allegedly optional failed component
evidence: DESIGN scope activation safe mode and transport isolation. No running daemon failure test performed
source_refs: D2 sections 1 and 6 scenarios.csv S045 S054 S055

name: External acceptance unknown
conditions: Forward intent exists but participant acceptance or durable outcome cannot be established after lost response dishonest acknowledgment or erased history
feedback: Repeated local reads cannot resolve remote truth. Safe refusal retains uncertainty whereas blind retries may create OP023
entry: Partition or plugin crash after possible external acceptance or unavailable reconciliation history
exit: Participant evidence resolves committed/not-committed or explicit human disposition records remaining uncertainty. A timeout alone is not evidence of failure
survives: Durable intended operation identity input reference and any independently recorded participant receipts under the design
lost: Knowledge of effect count and safe next action. Local intent is not proof of participant durability
falsifier: A durable authoritative participant outcome is already available and unambiguously tied to this operation
evidence: DESIGN saga journal/reconcile promise. QUALITATIVE communication ambiguity not observed production behavior

name: Duplicate business effects retained
kind: persistent external damage or excess work
conditions: Two accepted effects represent one intended business action because semantic identity was lost ignored or never shared
feedback: No necessary feedback after the duplicates. A repeated-retry loop is a separate condition rather than a property of duplicate charges
entry: Blind retry after unknown outcome or two independent tasks order the same product
exit: Participant-supported cancellation/refund or explicit business acceptance of duplicates. Irreversible messages remain delivered
survives: Task and participant evidence that actually survived and correctly completed unrelated work
lost: One-effect business intent and possibly money inventory or recipients' attention
falsifier: Participant evidence shows only one accepted effect despite every relevant retry/task identity
evidence: QUALITATIVE participant behavior. DESIGN idempotency is per intended mutation and cannot imply semantic deduplication across distinct tasks

name: Observer reports a stale or misleading reality
conditions: Client or adapter continues exposing old status or weak observations as current without authoritative refresh
feedback: Cached reads repeat the same misleading view. Operator action based on it can amplify damage but is not inevitable
entry: Disconnected client cache weak screen status or old restore opened without reconciliation
exit: Fresh correlated authoritative state with clear observation position. Actual historical gaps remain OP011
survives: Real core progress and intact local records can continue independently of the stale display
lost: Observer's ability to decide liveness completion or safe reuse from the displayed value
falsifier: Observer displays explicit staleness or refreshed cursor and does not claim the cached value is current
evidence: SOURCE Pi adapter suppresses weak task signals. Cache behavior is QUALITATIVE and transport cursors are DESIGN

name: Identity points to the wrong object
conditions: A reused pane path name or installation identity is treated as the original despite a different underlying actor or directory
feedback: Repeated routing through the stale association reproduces wrong attribution. It does not imply a self-correcting or attracting state
entry: Missing UUID fallback directory replacement case collision or mutable name retargeting
exit: Independent stable identity reconciliation and explicit resolution of already misrouted work
survives: Durable original IDs and evidence outside the bad association if retained
lost: Attribution intended routing and authority context. Content may survive at an unintended destination
falsifier: Identity mismatch is rejected before mutation or the supposedly replaced object is demonstrably identical
evidence: SOURCE missing harness UUID fallback accepts identity comparison. Other identity substitutions are QUALITATIVE branches

name: Guarded request refused without new effect
conditions: Request goes through a guard with required identity and transaction assumptions intact
feedback: No feedback or attraction. Repeating the same invalid request repeats rejection but does not create useful work
entry: Looping delegation occupied worker aliasing lease invalid result shape or invalid principal is detected
exit: Submit a materially valid authorized request or leave the rejected request finished
survives: Existing tasks assignments leases and readable evidence. Other valid work may continue
lost: Only the requested transition. Rejection is not itself a surviving business artifact
falsifier: The inspected guarded request mutates the protected state before returning its refusal
evidence: SOURCE delegation assignment completion and lease guards. End-to-end authentication is DESIGN only

name: Effect accepted outside the approved meaning
conditions: Participant accepts different content price target or timing from what the human actually authorized
feedback: No recurrence is required. Later retries or refreshes may propagate mismatch only if policy permits them
entry: Payload changes after approval or stale price is repriced or cancellation loses the acceptance race
exit: Record exact accepted effect and seek business-specific remedy or a new decision. Never relabel old approval as authorization for changed content
survives: Original approval intent and participant receipts if retained plus unrelated work
lost: Consent fidelity and possibly confidentiality money or contractual intent
falsifier: Accepted payload hash terms and acceptance moment all satisfy the actual scoped approval
evidence: QUALITATIVE race and semantic-binding hypothesis. External approval-binding implementation was not found in sampled crates

name: Irreversible effect already happened
kind: ordinary completed effect with possible regret
conditions: Participant has definitely accepted an effect that has no meaningful inverse
feedback: No feedback. Persistence is the nature of completed delivery or acceptance not an attractor
entry: Known email delivery or accepted action preceding local revocation
exit: Only a new mitigating business action where available. The original fact remains true
survives: Delivered work and authoritative receipt if available plus forward audit history
lost: Ability to make the original event never have occurred. Local cancellation cannot recover that
falsifier: Participant demonstrates that acceptance was provisional and an exact abort prevented the effect
evidence: DESIGN explicitly distinguishes irreversible from compensatable. Actual provider contract remains conditional

name: Compensation cannot finish
conditions: A known forward effect exists and inverse/mitigation repeatedly fails or lacks retained preconditions
feedback: Unchanged failing compensation reproduces failure until participant state policy or evidence changes. Infinite automatic retry needs an extra policy assumption
entry: Compensation failure or missing operation history/precondition data
exit: Operation-specific verified mitigation or explicit acceptance of unresolved business state
survives: Forward evidence and compensation attempts if durably recorded. Other independent saga steps may survive
lost: Claim of completed rollback and possibly business progress until disposition
falsifier: Compensation is proven successful with matching postconditions under unchanged preconditions
evidence: DESIGN compensation_failed/manual_intervention states. No actual saga runner behavior measured

name: Compensation damages newer work
conditions: Inverse acts on a value changed since the forward step or declared inverse is lossy
feedback: No attracting feedback required. Another blind repair may worsen divergence but is a further assumption
entry: Stale compensation overwrites human edits or a dishonest reversible operation discards data
exit: Recover independently retained newer version or business-specific remediation. Unique destroyed data enters OP006
survives: Forward/compensation audit evidence and unaffected external records if retained
lost: Newer legitimate work and the claim that inverse restores the business state
falsifier: Version-precondition rejects the inverse or verified before/after comparison proves exact preservation of intervening edits
evidence: DESIGN requires preconditions and tested compensation. Harmful inverse is QUALITATIVE violation branch

name: Decision service has no effective operator
conditions: Work requires a human who is absent uninformed or unable to interpret the blocker and no competent authorized substitute is available
feedback: No autonomous attraction. Repeated escalation to the same unavailable knowledge holder produces no new decision
entry: Sole operator offline opaque blocker unfamiliar replacement or inaccessible recovery
exit: Competent authorized person obtains the needed context and decides or work is cancelled. Mere dialog acknowledgment is not evidence of comprehension
survives: Queued work intent records and independent authorized tasks. Useful handover evidence survives only if actually retained
lost: Progress on human-dependent work and time-sensitive opportunities
falsifier: A competent authorized substitute resolves the case from the retained information without the allegedly exclusive owner
evidence: QUALITATIVE socio-technical dependency. Task blocking records alone do not establish a usable handover

name: Alarm-driven approval degradation
conditions: More failures generate more dialogs while limited human attention reduces review quality and wrong approvals cause additional failures
feedback: Incident load increases reflex acknowledgment which admits bad changes which increases incident load. Both causal links must be present
entry: Finite alarm burst exceeds meaningful review capacity under an acknowledgment-as-approval workflow
exit: Reduce incident generation or separate unreviewed load from binding decisions so error-driven arrivals fall below resolution
survives: Raw task intent and any independent evidence not destroyed. Dialog counts are not validated decisions
lost: Reliable human judgment and potentially trust in approval evidence
falsifier: After an initial burst alarm load subsides without changing workflow or approved errors do not create new alarms
evidence: QUALITATIVE feedback hypothesis with no behavioral data. Not an established human or Factory attractor

name: Remote control unavailable while local state may live
conditions: All operator remote paths are unavailable but local daemon/harness or disk remains independently functional
feedback: Network or credential unavailability maintains lack of control. Internal work need not stop and may deepen unobserved external commitments
entry: Remote network paths fail together or operator lacks physical access
exit: Independent trusted local access or restored remote path with refreshed state before action
survives: Local committed records and autonomous already-authorized processing if healthy
lost: Remote inspection and intervention. Not necessarily task progress or local IPC
falsifier: An independent authorized reachable control path exists under the same failure assumptions
evidence: QUALITATIVE shared-failure-domain analysis. DESIGN local IPC helps only a person who can reach the machine

name: Work bytes exist but no accepted completion
conditions: Worker produced a file but result commit was absent rejected or not attributable to the current run
feedback: Task remains nonterminal while repeated status reads cannot validate orphan bytes. No autonomous convergence follows
entry: Worker death before completion or oversized/empty result rejected or intermediate harness done
exit: Correlated artifact verification and an authorized valid completion or explicit failure. If bytes disappear use OP012
survives: Artifact bytes if durable and readable plus task attempt identity. Neither guarantees result quality
lost: Accepted final result and dependable lifecycle cleanup. Work need not be recomputed if evidence is sufficient
falsifier: An already committed valid result or reliable automatic verified reconciliation exists for the stated orphan artifact
evidence: SOURCE completion checks and adapter non-completion signals. Artifact reconciliation remains conditional

name: Cancelled record with potentially continuing delivery
conditions: Cancel interleaves after attempt commit but before writer invocation while task is still queued and no caller-wide serialization prevents it
feedback: No attraction. Terminal local status does not stop the later nontransactional writer and may conceal ongoing physical work
entry: Queued cancel commits cancelled and delivery then invokes its already prepared writer
exit: Correlate actual receipt and any worker effects then record an explicit disposition. Current authorise_resume cannot directly resume a cancelled task
survives: Cancellation record and delivery attempt survive if both commits are durable. Existing independent work remains useful
lost: Claim that cancelled means no prompt can still be emitted and clear attribution of later effects
falsifier: A mandatory caller lock or status check prevents writer invocation after cancellation at this exact cut point
evidence: SOURCE writer gap and queued cancel bodies support the interleaving only. No integrated race executed and manual writer merely renders a prompt
